parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) are complete, supported, and non-redundant. They accurately represent the parent high-level goal of providing citizens with a transparent and accessible reporting system through dual-view access to public reports on an interactive map and summary table. The LLGs cover essential capabilities such as displaying reports, applying filters, and sorting by various criteria. There are no unsupported or misleading LLGs, nor any missing essential capabilities.

The LLGs are well-documented and aligned with the source evidence from the project description. Each child LLG has a clear, distinct function that contributes to realizing the parent HLG without duplication. The scope of each child is appropriate, focusing on specific aspects of report visualization and interaction, rather than fragmenting the process into unnecessary UI mechanics.

The decision to KEEP_LOW_LEVEL_GOALS is justified by their completeness, support from source evidence, and adherence to the actor criterion. No regeneration is required as all essential parent capabilities are adequately represented in the children LLGs.
